text:
mei_lin: quick flag from onboarding Orchid-v3 (fp16 -> int4). fp16 detok is fine, int4 artifact shows mixed CJK punctuation and Arabic-Indic numerals splitting in vertical subtitle tests. sample below.
omar_khan: paste a minimal repro please

mei_lin: input (vertical/furigana style):
`
222
一《いちろう》は ٢٣٤ に向。
`
expected detok: `  一 ` (fp16 matches). int4 detok (wrong): `...  2 34 ` — Arabic-Indic cluster became `2 34` and some furigana markers separated.

tara_p: tokenizer/version parity? packaging step changes?

mei_lin: tokenizer v2026-05-10 pinned. pack log shows post-prune: `INFO: removed multi-codepoint tokens: 42 (includes U+0660..U+0669 clusters, ZWJ families, ruby brackets)`.

sven_b: sounds like pack-artifact pruning again. Rebuilt int4 with `--no-prune` and smoke shows detok parity with fp16.

omear_khan: evals-bot?

evals-bot: Regression alert: multilocale/vertical-detok BLEU -5.1 (int4 vs fp16). Triage ticket created: ML-5333.

tara_p: plan: (1) block int4 rollout, (2) add pack-artifact preflight checking token coverage for CJK punctuation, Arabic-Indic ranges, and ZWJ emoji, (3) emit prune-candidates file for audits. I'll open PRs.

sven_b: assigned rollback with eng-runtime. mei_lin please upload sample + pack log to ML-5333.

mei_lin: uploaded. thanks all — will follow up on test matrix to include vertical subtitle smoke in nightly runs. :white_check_mark:
